primary.description: Deep Navy Blue. Used for primary CTAs, dark sections, footer, and authoritative headers.

secondary.description: Government Gold. Used for accents, secondary buttons, timeline active states, and premium highlights.

accent.description: GIS Teal. Used for data visualizations, map overlays, tech capability badges.

background.description: Slate 50 background for clean, modern spaciousness.

h1.classes: font-heading font-semibold text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight text-[#0F2744]

h2.classes: font-heading font-semibold text-3xl sm:text-4xl tracking-tight text-[#0F2744]

h3.classes: font-heading font-semibold text-2xl sm:text-3xl tracking-tight text-[#1A202C]

overline.classes: font-heading text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#C8A44D] mb-2 block

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous whitespace. Asymmetric bento grids. Sharp or very minimal border radii (rounded-sm max) to convey seriousness and structural integrity. Do not use 'startup' bubbles.

navigation.style: Glassmorphism sticky header (bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#E2E8F0]). Logo left, links centered, secondary CTA right. Hide links in hamburger on mobile only.
navigation.active_state: Text color changes to #C8A44D, bottom border 2px solid #C8A44D.

hero.style: 80vh min-height. Heavy dark overlay (bg-[#0F2744]/75) over high-quality drone/infrastructure imagery. Content left-aligned. Trust bar at bottom spanning full width (logos of MMRDA, CIDCO, etc.).

service_cards.style: Rectangular cards, bg-white, 1px border-[#E2E8F0]. Top colored border (3px) in #C8A44D or #0F2744. Left-aligned content, subtle icon in #0E8B8B. Hover lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.

gis_dashboard_mockup.style: Dark mode bento grid embedded in a page section. bg-[#0A111A], border border-[#173A66]. Use #0E8B8B for data lines/graphs, tabular-nums for coordinates/stats. Must feel like enterprise software (ESRI/Bentley).

buttons.primary: bg-[#0F2744] text-white hover:bg-[#173A66] px-8 py-4 font-semibold tracking-wide transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-[#C8A44D] text-[#0F2744] hover:bg-[#DBC07B] px-8 py-4 font-semibold tracking-wide transition-all
buttons.outline: border-2 border-[#0F2744] text-[#0F2744] hover:bg-[#0F2744] hover:text-white px-8 py-4 font-semibold transition-all

timeline.style: Left-bordered vertical line (border-l-2 border-[#E2E8F0]). Nodes in #C8A44D. Content cards offset with generous padding. Slide-in animation on scroll.

trust_bar.style: Grayscale logos with opacity-50. Hover: opacity-100 and full color. Generous gap-12.

footer.style: bg-[#0F2744] text-white py-24. High contrast. Large brand statement (h2 text-white). Grid of links. Gold accents.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Smooth scroll (Lenis recommended if possible). Sections fade in and slide up slightly (y: 20 -> 0).
motion_and_interactions.hover: Buttons fill or lift. Cards lift subtly. No extreme scaling or spinning.
motion_and_interactions.gis_maps: Fade in with slow scale up (1.05 -> 1.0) over 1.5s.

sections: Hero (Drone + Dark Overlay + Left Aligned Text + Primary CTA)
Why Choose Us (Split Section: Image left, content right)
GIS Capabilities Showcase (Dark theme dashboard mockup)
Service Categories Grid (Land Surveying, Land Acquisition, GIS, Revenue Records, Infrastructure Advisory, Architecture)
Filterable Portfolio Grid (Land Survey, GIS, etc.)
Leads Data Table (Shadcn Table, sorting, filtering)

visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle noise overlay (opacity-5) on dark sections to prevent flatness.
visual_enhancers.pattern: SVG Topographic map lines with opacity-5 in #0F2744 on the light #F8FAFC background sections.
visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react for all standard icons. Stroke width 1.5. Use #C8A44D or #0E8B8B for icon colors.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on role.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI components for complex interactions (Tables, Forms, Nav Menu), but heavily customize to match the exact color palette and sharp radius rules.
DO NOT use generic shadow-md everywhere. Follow the precise borders and subtle shadows in the spacing_and_layout rules.
Ensure the Topographic background pattern is very subtle so as not to reduce text legibility.
Keep standard pages light theme (#F8FAFC), but use the deep navy (#0F2744) for footers, hero overlays, and the GIS capabilities section.
Ensure robust routing between all 8 pages.
The admin view should be a separate route (e.g., /admin) with a data table component.
Always use the text hierarchy defined in typography.h1 to typography.h4.
Make sure the navbar is sticky with a glassmorphism effect.
Do not use generic placeholder images like via.placeholder.com. ONLY use the media_assets URLs provided in this JSON.
Apply data-testid to every button, link, form input, and structural card.
Use React Hook Form and Zod for the Contact/Careers forms.
